decisions.slice: I-4-4D3: migrate steps/step-4-pr-review.md, step-5-feedback-and-termination.md and step-5-mergeability-handling.md with a minimal recorded difference and restore the 6 B1/B2 source test functions that need only documents. No wrapper, shared schema or permanent gate is added; the existing runner is reused.
decisions.no_placeholder: The documents are the migrated real files, not fixtures or placeholders. The restored tests read them and run the real adjudicator CLI / local fixtures.
decisions.references: The documents name Skill, Agent and script targets that are not migrated. They are not started as if they existed; each is classified in unmigrated_references with its owner. Live GitHub / Git operations in the documents are examples only and are never executed here.
decisions.legacy_content: Legacy Issue/PR numbers and the legacy repository slug remain as historical text inside the documents; they are recorded rather than rewritten, to keep source parity reviewable.
decisions.oracle_boundary: B1 test_terminal_gate_resolves_semantic_ambiguity needs the push-capable replay executor and real Git ref operations. It stays deferred (owner I-4-4C); D3 neither migrates nor runs that executor and mutates no Git ref.
decisions.production_claim: Migrating these documents does not make production Step 4 / Step 5 or the Final Gate run; Skill entrypoint, Agents and wiring are later I-4-4D slices.
